findings.evidence: InvariantMass.lean:110-112 (`variable (hq ...) (hq' : q.spatialPart = k • n)` for the whole `RealPhoton` section), line 195-198 and 227 for the energy-fraction forms; Kinematics/Basic.lean:321-332 (`virtuality_pos_of_mem_photonRegion`, `not_isReal_of_mem_photonRegion`). The author's stated rationale ("a spacelike photon has none") concerns the photon's own rapidity, not the system rapidity these lemmas state, which is well defined for `Q² > 0`.
findings.fix: Expose the collinear virtual-photon forms: for `hq' : q.spatialPart = a • n`, `a` is fixed by the virtuality via `minkowskiProduct_self_eq_mul_of_spatialPart_eq_smul` (`a² = (q⁰)² + Q²`), giving `W² = M² - Q² + 2 (x E_s E + p a)` and `e^{2y} = (q⁰ + a + E - p) / (q⁰ - a + E + p)`, so x, y and W are interchangeable at nonzero virtuality.
findings.issue: Every rapidity and inversion lemma (and `minkowskiProduct_add_self_of_realPhoton_energyFraction`) is gated on `hq : q.timeComponent = k` together with `hq' : q.spatialPart = k • n`, i.e. `⟪q,q⟫ₘ = 0`. But `ChargedSource.not_isReal_of_mem_photonRegion` (Kinematics/Basic.lean:329) proves every photon of `s.photonRegion θmax` for `0 < s.mass` has `virtuality > 0`, so for any physically emitted photon the exposed surface stops at `minkowskiProduct_add_self_of_target_energyFraction` (line 204), whose statement still carries the raw `⟪q.spatialPart, n⟫_ℝ` — not determined by `(x, Q²)` and the target data. The roadmap's three-way interchangeability is therefore unavailable in the physical region.

findings.evidence: Rapidity.lean:90-111 exposes only `exp_rapidity`/`exp_two_mul_rapidity`; `Real.artanh_eq_half_log` exists at upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Artanh.lean:55, so the restatement is a two-line proof.
findings.fix: Add `rapidity_eq_half_log` next to `exp_two_mul_rapidity`, from `Real.artanh_eq_half_log` or by `Real.log_exp` on `exp_two_mul_rapidity`.
findings.issue: No lemma states the closed form `v.rapidity n = ½ log ((v⁰ + v_∥) / (v⁰ - v_∥))`, the literature's definition of rapidity and the one the module docstring asserts at line 20-21 ("it is half the logarithm of the ratio of the two light-cone components"). Only `exp`-side forms are exposed, so a consumer needing `y` itself must invert `exp` by hand.

summary: The surface is minimal, bodies are hidden and there is no compatibility layer, but the x↔y↔W dictionary is exposed only under hypotheses that force Q²=0 — a configuration the companion module proves no massive source emits — and the rapidity has no closed-form log restatement despite the module docstring claiming one.
